{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|There are organs known as 'kidneys,' [...] One on either side of the lower back, just above the hips. A strike there causes considerable anguish, often so severe that the victim is unable to cry out.|[[Nom Anor]] to [[Shimrra Jamaane]]|<ref name="Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>}}
'''Kidneys''' or '''nephri'''<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> were organs located near the lower back on [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Ylesia" /> Although naturally having both a left and right kidney,<ref name="shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> Humans were able to survive with only one kidney.<ref name="Ylesia" /> Kidneys could be transplanted<ref name="medstar">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> and even cloned if that was needed.<ref name="swarmwar">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

Diffrent species can have a diffrent number of kidneys. For example members of the [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] species have four kidneys. [[Exogorth/Legends|Exogorths]] had ten nephri.<ref name="Wildlife" />

Hitting a person in the kidneys caused extreme—often disabling—pain for the victim.<ref name="Ylesia" /> Older Humans often suffered from [[Zithrom's syndrome]], which resulted in shrunken kidneys, among other symptoms.<ref name="donoharm">{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm}}</ref>

Kidney stones could accumulate within the kidneys and be passed from the body.<ref name="twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

[[Yuuzhan Vong]] typically lacked kidneys.
